notes.title: Visual Upgrade! v1.06
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
[b]City Climber[/b] was released on Steam exactly one year ago, so I've decided to upgrade the game's visuals as a little surprise! Game now uses volumetric lighting and bunch of cool postprocessing effects. They can be all turned on/off in the in-game options. I also fixed some bugs and tweaked gameplay mechanics. Don't forget to check out the new trailer and screenshots on the game's store page! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/5a6f098555133fd6d97370b4628e2adf993725f6.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Improved visuals
- Fixed UI not being scaled properly
- Improved climbing controls when using mouse / gamepad
- Falling objects are now visibly damaged, so you can tell more easily what is not safe to grab
- Added new settings in in-game options
- Fixed collider in various places, so stuff should be easier to grab.

Have a nice day!  ːclimberbottleː ːclimberpaperː

notes.title: New gameplay content incoming! We have passed 1000 sales!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys![/h1]
Sorry for my inactivity in recent weeks. 
I had to relax for a bit (replay HL2 + episodes), get my thoughts together,  and decide what's comming next.

[h1] We have passed 1000 sales! [/h1]
I may be saying this too much, but seriously, [b]Thank you[/b] for your amazing support. It's great to see that you are enjoying the game and having fun with it.

and that's why... 
[h1] I'm working on additional gameplay content! [/h1]
Which basically means that I am working on two new challenge modes. They should add up to around 30-40 minutes of gameplay time. It should be all ready in about 1-2 weeks, in form of a free update.ːsteamhappyː

Sneak-peek:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/a6ff3d276d14113136e0043b259ed0456d8cee12.png[/img]

Also, [b]I would like to create a small screenshot competition[/b] (climber steam-keys as a prize) Would you be interested in it? Please leave a comment so I can see if there are any people who would consider joining!

Have a nice day! ːsteamhappyː
- Ondrej

notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys![/h1]
We are releasing on the next Friday and I would like to talk to you about all the progress that had been made on City Climber since we passed Greenlight.ːsteamhappyː

First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for all the amazing support!
I`m working on City Climber alone, so it really helps to see, that there are people who are looking forward to playing it!

One of the things you might have noticed, Is that I pushed the release date to a later date maybe 2 or 3 times. Let`s say that one thing led to another... and I have quit my university so I could focus on making City Climber as good as possible. Suddenly I had time to improve a lot of things that I was not happy about. So I did ! It took a while but I`m really happy with the results. ːsteamhappyː See for yourself!

Here are some screenshots from the old greenlight trailer, side by side with the screenshots from the latest version of City Climber.

[h1]Sewers[/h1]
- old design used in greenlight trailer
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/dc24c0ffb46fc438aaefc693050dac66a70c28f9.png[/img]

- latest redesigned version
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/082a985148402a5ef99d2f8c07b219074bcaa7fc.png[/img]

[h1]Space Station[/h1]
- old design used in greenlight trailer
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/772ed5308516468d0f18e21709cfa84579743618.png[/img]

- latest redesigned version
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/5b14b0aa1e46512b6092ce93bd5a221c728c39bb.png[/img]

[h1]Laboratory[/h1]
- old design used in greenlight trailer
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/b47e73df28945718ce50711abd84e9af6a4e2268.png[/img]

- latest redesigned version
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/0d8d6e9d1c6760bbc38d6ef96f6a9da90b8761d8.png[/img]

[h1]Space Station - second area[/h1]
- old design used in greenlight trailer
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/88838e3628654999758dd408c10029ed5d4732e7.png[/img]

- latest redesigned version
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/a2a4e1757bae4f91fda686fcf1425774070eed8d.png[/img]

[h1]Rooftops[/h1]
- old design used in greenlight trailer
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/212fb0e43037b24dcbdc75a46711164c5ae3b8fe.png[/img]

- latest redesigned version
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/12c0f1bc86804a8be123ef7f7545e79340283534.png[/img]

There are currently 14 story levels and they usually take around 2-3 hours to complete. I have also implemented Achievements and steam leaderboards so you can compete with your friends and improve your rank!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/482e6308bf94acfe8dacf0393b37599c5dcc8763.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/8b43d936b4c4412a7a908a8dc8c0e83a9d4ff029.png[/img]

Trading cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons will be also available. I have uploaded them to Steam just yesterday! ːsteamhappyː

Oh.. I almost forgot! You can also enjoy story mode in local co-op (two controllers), where you play as a robot with two differently colored arms. Each player controls only one arm, so you have to comunicate a lot!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/e00f16909f024bafd0b90a49c5738eaa911eb35f.png[/img]

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
Challenges are the "more crazy" part of the game. There are currently 10 leves for each mode, always with some funny new twist. They usually take around 1 hour to complete.

[b]Step by Step[/b]
Objective: roll to the end of stairs!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/de066ba4d27769de1a6177d95422eaa836167797.png[/img]

[b]Leap of Faith[/b]
Objective: jump from a crane and hit the target below!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/ade3943b3a35bfe674ca5c249e3ec2bf22227a51.png[/img]

[b]Crazy Carts[/b]
Objective: Ride a vehicle propelled by fire extinguishers and reach the finish line! [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/9791199f4e5595f2429c84bc287ddef6985604cb.png[/img]

[h1]Party Mode[/h1]
Pary Mode is local, turned based competitive multiplayer. You select your characters and each player gets randomly selected set of chalenges he has to complete. Player with the most points wins! :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/1d446646fb096f2ec776b5efe529e307b9155070.png[/img]

(That purple guy is in the middle of his fall :D .. there is an interactive screen like this before start of each challenge. It basically shows, whose turn it is)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/2bd4ad31e19b9aa6673ed6a7e50a0f1528408a87.png[/img]

There is a lot more I would like to show you but I don`t want to post too many spoilers. :) In conclusion - I hope you will enjoy playing City Climber and have ton of fun with it! I will be updating the store page with new description, trailer and screenshots tomorrow. 

See you around! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Dev Log & Postponed release
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I know these are pretty sad news. But I had to postpone the release date of City Climber to Q1 of 2017 (early 2017). 

Main reason for this decision, is that there are massive sales on Steam during end of the year, and small games like City Climber just get lost in all the discounted titles. I`m really sorry about the delay but I just cannot compete againts discounted AAA games during their biggest sales. I hope that you will understand.

Otherwise, development is going pretty good and game is really shaping up! 
Check out the new videos in the latest article on IndieDB:
http://www.indiedb.com/games/city-climber/news/city-climber-dev-log-18

See you next week! ːsteamhappyː
